description: Every N-central REST endpoint, plus an offline SQLite mirror of your whole org tree, cross-tenant search, issue-triage rollups, and a JWT-expiry guardian no other N-central tool has.

novel_features.name: Multi-server cross-tenant search
novel_features.description: Search every configured N-central server at once — find a device, customer, or active issue across all your tenants without clicking through each console.

novel_features.name: Custom-property drift/coverage audit
novel_features.description: Report which devices or org units are missing a required custom-property value, as a coverage percentage grouped by customer.

novel_features.name: Active-issue triage rollup
novel_features.description: Group active monitoring issues by customer, device, or monitor type and rank by severity — the daily NOC sweep as one command.

novel_features.name: JWT / password-expiry guardian
novel_features.description: Validate the access token, warn when the API user's password (and thus the JWT) is about to expire, and detect N-central's HTTP-200-with-error-body failures.

novel_features.name: Maintenance-window gap report
novel_features.description: List devices and sites with no maintenance window before a reboot/patch wave, so nothing reboots in business hours.

novel_features.name: Cross-tenant device locator
novel_features.description: Given a device name fragment, return its full path — server, service org, customer, site — plus its current active-issue count.
